datasets.title: Cyber Attack Manifestations Log Data Set v2
datasets.ground_truth: attackmate time intervals; idle and unlabeled events must be UNKNOWN, not benign
datasets.notes: Scenario archives include host logs, Suricata, Wazuh and time-based attackmate labels; missing realistic benign user sessions means no operational false-positive estimate.

datasets.title: Session-Aware Multi-Layer Attack Detection Dataset
datasets.ground_truth: publisher reports attack-instance identifiers; validate labels against files before scoring
datasets.notes: Record is v2; ZIP filename is v1. No training/test leakage across attack_instance_id.
datasets.label_audit: Read 2026-11-26 from the publisher's code/extract_features.py (lines 367-389, 705-711): each of the 5,840 L7 label events is assigned to one request, the nearest unused one within 30 s; every other request (about 192,000 of 198,082) is labelled by label_l7_payload(), the publisher's own payload pattern rule, which defaults to NORMAL. Request-level labels therefore mostly reproduce a signature detector, and NORMAL means only that no pattern matched. All traffic, benign and attack, comes from one source IP (192.168.70.132). The label file records step start times without end times.

datasets.title: CTU-SME-11
datasets.ground_truth: benign / malicious / background separated; background is UNKNOWN unless independently annotated
datasets.notes: Full collection ~80 GB compressed according to author description; use explicit opt-in per device and keep collection environment IDs.

datasets.title: HIKARI-2021 (existing project benchmark)
datasets.ground_truth: available labeled flows; original held-out evaluations have failed targets
datasets.notes: Not a novel external evaluation; repeated tuning on previously scored HIKARI is exploratory.

datasets.title: GeNIS
datasets.notes: Do not ingest before reuse terms and publisher hashes reviewed.

datasets.title: Gotham IoT
datasets.notes: 23.8GB archive is not appropriate for free CI.

datasets.title: Unified Packet-Flow IDS sets
datasets.ground_truth: label and original-source rights must be reviewed per component
datasets.notes: Do not call this independent new environment unless underlying source captures differ.

datasets.title: Superviz25-SQL: SQL Injection Detection Dataset
datasets.publisher: Telecom Paris, LAAS-CNRS, Inria Rennes (Quetel, Alata, Gimenez, Robert, Pautet)
datasets.ground_truth: by construction: benign from 65 query templates filled with legitimate OurAirports values; attacks generated by sqlmap campaigns with technique, stage, tamper script and campaign success recorded
datasets.notes: Benign traffic is synthetic and template-generated; benign train and test come from the same generator. Queries and user inputs only, no HTTP responses or host telemetry.

datasets.title: Web Server Log Dataset: Indonesian public-sector organizations X and Y
datasets.ground_truth: publisher supplies pattern-matching rules; non-matching events are UNKNOWN, never confirmed benign
datasets.notes: 2025 traffic; labels are rule-generated, so do not score true false-positive rate or recall. X and Y are independent sites but within the same publisher release. Do not disclose raw paths, addresses or user-agent strings in output.

datasets.title: Online Shop Server Logs for Bot Traffic and Web Usage Analysis (Dec 2025)
datasets.publisher: Grzegorz Chodak, Wrocław University of Science and Technology
datasets.ground_truth: no verified benign or malicious request labels
datasets.notes: URI query strings and fragment identifiers removed by publisher; not suitable for input-field SQLi detection, host instrumentation or original fused DVWA-v3 scoring. Opt into 35 MB limit.

datasets.title: EClog: HTTP-level e-commerce data based on server access logs
datasets.notes: Publisher's scientific article documents masked/structured URIs but does not establish the Dataverse dataset's rights. A default Dataverse CC0 is not proof of this particular dataset's terms. Harvard Dataverse page has browser verification challenge.

datasets.title: Website Access Logs, Cloud and Distributed Systems Laboratory
datasets.notes: README reports 5,736,834 entries; sampled 2026 doktor access log includes some query strings. Repo API returned license:null. Contents not ingested pending rights confirmation.

datasets.title: Biblio-US17: labeled University of Seville HTTP URI traces
datasets.publisher: University of Seville, Díaz-Verdejo et al.
datasets.ground_truth: sanitized and partially signature/expert-assisted labeling, not independently verified benign truth
datasets.notes: 47 million recorded requests; official repository currently shows Request a Copy for dataset files. Do not conflate paper CC BY with dataset reuse rights.
